title: AI visibility (AEO / GEO)
for: how AI answer engines mention and cite us and competitors against the prompt set in data/seo/prompts.csv

manual.export: Run the prompt set by hand in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, record which brands are mentioned and which pages are cited in a CSV (one row per prompt and engine), or export the visibility report from the AEO tool, and drop it into the snapshots folder.

vendors.name: DataForSEO AI Optimization
caveats: Same server and entry as seo-data (server name `dataforseo`); the ai_optimization_* and ai_opt_llm_ment_* tools are what brand-monitor uses
Every call costs API credits; the LLM response tools call the model live and are the most expensive
The remote endpoint https://mcp.dataforseo.com/v3/mcp takes HTTP Basic auth, which .mcp.json cannot express as a ${VAR} header; swap by hand if Node.js is unavailable

vendors.name: Profound
caveats: The npm package @profoundai/mcp is the official server generated from Profound's TypeScript SDK; it reads PROFOUND_API_KEY (the SDK docs name it) and optionally PROFOUND_ACCESS_TOKEN; the hosted endpoint https://mcp.tryprofound.com/ is announced on the blog but its auth header is not documented, so only the local variant is wired

script.notes: copy scripts/seo_snapshot.py; the same key calls the Profound REST API for a scheduled visibility snapshot per model

vendors.name: Peec AI
caveats: OAuth-only and read-only; no headless path beyond the manual export
Community thein-art/mcp-server-peecai adds CRUD (2 stars); judge it as a script and prefer the official read-only server

vendors.name: Otterly.ai
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__otterly`) until checked (the writes add prompts and audits, permission-gated on Otterly's side)
The endpoint URL comes from a secondary listing; the vendor page is JavaScript-rendered and could not be read, confirm before wiring

vendors.name: Scrunch AI
caveats: No MCP server found on the vendor site or in any directory as of 2026-09-04; the row exists so the team sees the vendor was checked
Use the manual export of Scrunch's visibility report until a server appears

vendors.name: Athena (AthenaHQ)
caveats: No MCP server found as of 2026-09-04; the athena-mcp repositories on GitHub belong to unrelated products
Use the manual export of the AthenaHQ report until a server appears
